<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fix NIXL transfers of Mamba/SSM hybrid state on block-outermost KV cache layouts (`BLHNC`, `BLNHC`), and add a CPU test that pulls one request between two NIXL workers on real model KV layouts and checks every byte.

Related: vllm-project/vllm#63416 changes how NIXL pairs regions. This PR does not depend on it, and #63416 rebases onto it without conflicts.

## Claims

- **Fix.** With `VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC`, Qwen3-Next (GDN) and Nemotron-H (Mamba2) disaggregated P/D read the wrong Mamba state and wrote outside the request's blocks, with no error. They now transfer correctly. Layer-outermost layouts (the default) are unchanged. Hybrids whose attention is MLA, such as Kimi-Linear, were not affected (see Root cause).
- **Test.** The NIXL unit tests build KV cache configs and tensors by hand. The new test plans and allocates both sides with vLLM's own planner (`get_kv_cache_configs`) and allocator (`allocate_kv_cache`), from the per-layer KV specs of 12 models. D pulls one request from P through the real worker code; the recorded descriptors run as memory copies. Every page of every layer must land in D's block for the same layer and request position, and no other D byte may change.

## Validation

CPU only: `VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=""`. No weights or model code: the KV specs are built in the test.

```
pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_desc_geometry.py -k real_model
# 14 passed in ~10 s
```

| Case | KV plan in the test (groups → regions) | Layout |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen3-8B (same shape as GLM-4.5-Air, MiniMax-M2) | 4 full, 1 → 4 | auto (LBHNC) |
| gpt-oss-20b | SW + full, 2 → 2 shared | auto |
| Gemma 3 1B | 10 SW + 2 full, 6 → 2 shared | auto |
| MiMo-V2-Flash | 9 SW + 3 full, 4 → 3 shared | auto |
| DeepSeek-V3 (same as Kimi-K2) | 4 MLA, 1 → 4 | auto; BLNHC → BLNHC; BLNHC P → LBNHC D |
| DeepSeek-V3.2 | MLA + indexer cache, 1 → 8 | auto |
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B | 6 GDN + 2 full, 4 → 2 shared | auto; BLHNC |
| NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 | 11 Mamba2 + 2 full, 7 → 2 shared | auto; BLHNC |
| Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B | 6 KDA + 2 MLA, 4 → 2 shared | auto; BLNHC |

Fails before the fix: the new test with `main`'s `base_worker.py`:

```
pytest -q tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_desc_geometry.py -k "real_model and BLHNC"
FAILED ...[Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-BLHNC-BLHNC]
  AssertionError: ['model.layers.0.linear_attn[0].0', 'model.layers.4.linear_attn[0].0', ...]
FAILED ...[NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-BLHNC-BLHNC]
  AssertionError: ['model.layers.0.mixer[0].0', 'model.layers.11.mixer[0].0', ...]
2 failed
```

Every GDN/Mamba2 page arrives wrong. With the fix, all 14 cases pass.

The test also catches descriptor bugs it was not written for: dropping the conv-state offset from the peer's SSM descriptor (`_build_mamba_remote`) fails the three layer-outermost hybrid cases.

NIXL unit suites (`test_nixl_desc_geometry.py`, `test_nixl_connector_hma.py`, `test_nixl_push_connector.py`, `test_nixl_connector.py`), on `main` and on this branch:

| Tree | Passed | Failed |
|---|---|---|
| `main` @ `4e0ad5720` | 646 | 4 |
| this branch | 660 | 4, the same ones |

- **The 4 failures on both:** `test_fewer_blocks_with_hma` needs a gated HF repo, `test_abort_timeout_on_prefiller[ray, None]` needs Ray/GPU, and `test_register_packed_dsv4_mla_cache_as_single_region[v41-aliased-groups]` fails on `main` as well.
- **Transient failures:** the branch's first suite run also had 11 consecutive failures in `test_nixl_desc_geometry.py`, during a period of HF Hub rate limiting (see below). All 11 passed on rerun, and a full run of that file passed (271 tests).

`pre-commit` passes on the changed files.

Note on flakiness: the new test builds two `create_vllm_config` configs per case, as other NIXL unit tests do. When the HF Hub rate-limits the `facebook/opt-125m` file listing (HTTP 429), any of these tests fails in setup. That was the only failure cause seen in about 600 local runs of the new test.

## Details

**Root cause.** Under the hybrid KV cache manager, cache groups share KV cache tensors. With a block-outermost layout, block *b* of every tensor sits side by side in one row, so a layer's view advances by the row: 4,718,592 B for Qwen3-Next's two tensors in the test, not by one 2,359,296 B page. `register_kv_caches` registered Mamba regions with `block_stride = physical_page_size` and took the view's stride only for CSA-linear. So every Mamba descriptor past block 0 pointed into the other tensor's pages. Attention regions on the same rows already used the view stride.

Only some hybrids hit it. A shared region keeps the stride of the first layer registered into it (layer-name order), and a later layer replaces it only if it is MLA. Mamba sub-region descriptors use the region's stride:
- In Qwen3-Next and Nemotron-H a Mamba layer comes first, and their full-attention layers never replace its page stride.
- In Kimi-Linear the MLA layer replaces it with the row stride, so its KDA descriptors were right by accident; the Kimi-Linear BLNHC case passes with or without the fix.

The fix takes the view's stride for Mamba views on block-outermost layouts too. Elsewhere the page stride stays. A view indexed by kernel block (several per logical block) has a stride of a fraction of the page, and taking the view's stride there breaks the existing hetero-block-size tests.

Flow (pull, the failing case):
1. Startup, P and D: `register_kv_caches` registers each region as `(base, len, stride, count)`; Mamba regions get stride = one page.
2. Handshake: D builds descriptors for P's Mamba sub-regions (conv q/k/v parts, SSM state) from P's metadata, and its own from its local regions.
3. Read: a descriptor id for block *b* resolves to `base + b × stride`. With stride = page instead of row, block *b*'s address lands in another tensor's page of a lower block, on both sides.

**The test.**
- Models are those tested end to end for vllm-project/vllm#63416. MiniMax-M1 is left out; vLLM removed it in 0.23.0.
- Specs mirror what each model's layers return. Nine were dumped from a meta-device model build on CPU. DeepSeek-V3.2 (sparse MLA + indexer) and Kimi-Linear (MLA + KDA) cannot be built on CPU, so their specs come from their configs and vLLM's state-shape helpers.
- Each case uses the first layers of its model, enough for its group and region pattern (2 regions for the hybrids). The largest case allocates about 120 MB per side.
- Hybrid block sizes are the ones vLLM aligns to on CPU (1152, 1408). For Kimi-Linear it is 1920, the first 64-token multiple whose MLA page holds the KDA state.

**Not covered.**
- Push, TP mismatch, PP stages, and P and D with different settings. With the same model and settings the region pairing is the identity; those cases stay with the hand-built tests.
- GPU, and an end-to-end P/D run with `VLLM_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=BLHNC` on a hybrid model.

**Mocks.** `tests/AGENTS.md` asks for real objects. The workers are patched the same way as the existing `_make_mla_hybrid_worker` helper in this file:
- the platform reports a CUDA device, so the GPU registration path runs on a CPU host;
- attention backends and kernel block-size selection are faked, since no model layers are built;
- TP rank and size are fixed at 0 and 1;
- NIXL itself is the file's `_RecordingNixl`.

Planner, allocator, layout resolution, registration, handshake and descriptor code are all real.

**Not a duplicate.** vllm-project/vllm#62453 fixes Mamba page padding on the CPU host-buffer path, and vllm-project/vllm#64140 fixes packed Mamba addressing in the KV offloading worker. Neither touches NIXL's Mamba region stride.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for this change. The submitter reviews every changed line.

@@ -32,12 +32,17 @@
 from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.push_worker import (
     NixlPushConnectorWorker,
 )
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import MambaAttentionBackendEnum
 from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    FullAttentionSpec,
     KVCacheConfig,
     KVCacheGroupSpec,
     KVCacheLayout,
     KVCacheTensor,
+    MambaSpec,
     MLAAttentionSpec,
+    SlidingWindowSpec,
+    SparseCacheRole,
     create_kv_cache_views,
 )
 
@@ -1840,3 +1845,379 @@ def test_shared_base_regions_with_distinct_block_lens_stay_separate():
     np.testing.assert_array_equal(
         descs[:, 0], [base[0], base[0] + 256, base[0], base[0] + 256]
     )
+
+
+# Real model KV layouts, end to end on CPU: vLLM's planner and allocator build
+# P's and D's caches, D reads one request from P, and the recorded descriptors
+# are run as memory copies so every byte can be checked. Each case is the
+# first layers of a model with that model's per-layer KV specs. Hybrid block
+# sizes are the ones vLLM aligns to on CPU, where the attention page must hold
+# the Mamba state.
+_BF16 = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def _attn(heads, head, head_v=None, window=None):
+    def make(block_size, _mamba_page):
+        kwargs = dict(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=heads,
+            head_size=head,
+            head_size_v=head_v or head,
+            dtype=_BF16,
+        )
+        if window is not None:
+            return SlidingWindowSpec(sliding_window=window, **kwargs)
+        return FullAttentionSpec(**kwargs)
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _mla(head=576, dtype=_BF16, **kwargs):
+    def make(block_size, _mamba_page):
+        return MLAAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=1,
+            head_size=head,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _mamba(shapes, mamba_type):
+    def make(block_size, mamba_page):
+        return MambaSpec(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            shapes=shapes,
+            dtypes=(_BF16, torch.float32),
+            page_size_padded=mamba_page,
+            mamba_type=mamba_type,
+        )
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _layers(n, make):
+    return [entry for i in range(n) for entry in make(i)]
+
+
+_GDN = MambaAttentionBackendEnum.GDN_ATTN
+# (block size, [(layer name, spec factory)]) per model.
+_REAL_MODELS = {
+    # GLM-4.5-Air and MiniMax-M2 have the same attention shape.
+    "Qwen3-8B": (
+        128,
+        _layers(4, lambda i: [(f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn", _attn(8, 128))]),
+    ),
+    "gpt-oss-20b": (
+        128,
+        _layers(
+            4,
+            lambda i: [
+                (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.attn.attn",
+                    _attn(8, 64, window=None if i % 2 else 128),
+                )
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+    "gemma-3-1b": (
+        128,
+        _layers(
+            12,
+            lambda i: [
+                (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn",
+                    _attn(1, 256, window=None if i % 6 == 5 else 512),
+                )
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+    "MiMo-V2-Flash": (
+        128,
+        _layers(
+            12,
+            lambda i: [
+                (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn",
+                    _attn(4, 192, 128)
+                    if i in (0, 5, 11)
+                    else _attn(8, 192, 128, window=128),
+                )
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+    # Kimi-K2 has the same MLA cache.
+    "DeepSeek-V3": (
+        128,
+        _layers(4, lambda i: [(f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn", _mla())]),
+    ),
+    "DeepSeek-V3.2": (
+        64,
+        _layers(
+            4,
+            lambda i: [
+                (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn",
+                    _mla(is_index_group_leader=True),
+                ),
+                (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.indexer.k_cache",
+                    _mla(132, torch.uint8, cache_role=SparseCacheRole.INDEXER),
+                ),
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+    "Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B": (
+        1152,
+        _layers(
+            8,
+            lambda i: [
+                (f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn", _attn(2, 256))
+                if i % 4 == 3
+                else (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.linear_attn",
+                    _mamba(((8192, 3), (32, 128, 128)), _GDN),
+                )
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+    "NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2": (
+        1408,
+        _layers(
+            22,
+            lambda i: (
+                [
+                    (
+                        f"model.layers.{i}.mixer",
+                        _mamba(
+                            ((12288, 3), (128, 80, 128)),
+                            MambaAttentionBackendEnum.MAMBA2,
+                        ),
+                    )
+                ]
+                if i in (0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 11, 13, 16, 18, 20)
+                else [(f"model.layers.{i}.mixer.attn", _attn(8, 128))]
+                if i in (14, 21)
+                else []
+            ),
+        ),
+    ),
+    # KDA at 1-based layers 1-3, 5-7; MLA at 4 and 8. A 1920-token MLA page
+    # (64-token kernel blocks) is the first to hold the 2,170,880 B KDA state.
+    "Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B": (
+        1920,
+        _layers(
+            8,
+            lambda i: [
+                (f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn.attn", _mla())
+                if i % 4 == 3
+                else (
+                    f"model.layers.{i}.self_attn",
+                    _mamba(((12288, 3), (32, 128, 128)), _GDN),
+                )
+            ],
+        ),
+    ),
+}
+_LAYOUT_PREFERENCE = ["LBNHC", "LBHNC", "BLNHC", "BLHNC", "BHLNC", "LHBNC"]
+
+
+def _real_model_side(model, layout):
+    """Plan and allocate one side's KV caches the way the engine does, with
+    just enough blocks for one request of one or two blocks per group."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import resolve_kv_cache_layout
+    from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning import (
+        get_global_kv_cache_groups,
+        get_kv_cache_configs,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.utils import allocate_kv_cache
+
+    block_size, layers = _REAL_MODELS[model]
+    vllm_config = create_vllm_config(
+        block_size=block_size, max_model_len=block_size, kv_role="kv_both"
+    )
+    vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len = block_size
+    vllm_config.cache_config.enable_prefix_caching = False
+    vllm_config.cache_config.kv_cache_layout = layout
+    vllm_config.kv_transfer_config.kv_buffer_device = "cuda"
+    # A Mamba page is padded to the attention page, which holds it.
+    specs = {name: make(block_size, None) for name, make in layers}
+    mamba_page = max(
+        (
+            spec.page_size_bytes
+            for spec in specs.values()
+            if not isinstance(spec, MambaSpec)
+        ),
+        default=None,
+    )
+    specs = {name: make(block_size, mamba_page) for name, make in layers}
+    resolved = resolve_kv_cache_layout(
+        vllm_config, [_LAYOUT_PREFERENCE], specs.values()
+    )
+    groups = get_global_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, [specs])
+    vllm_config.cache_config.num_gpu_blocks_override = 2 + sum(
+        _blocks_per_request(g.kv_cache_spec) for g in groups
+    )
+    kv_cache_config = get_kv_cache_configs(vllm_config, [specs], [1 << 40], groups)[0]
+    kv_cache_config.kv_cache_layout = vllm_config.cache_config.kv_cache_layout
+    caches = allocate_kv_cache(
+        kv_cache_config,
+        torch.device("cpu"),
+        resolved,
+        [g.kv_cache_spec.block_size for g in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups],
+    )
+    return vllm_config, kv_cache_config, caches
+
+
+def _blocks_per_request(spec):
+    return 1 if isinstance(spec, MambaSpec) else 2
+
+
+def _real_model_worker(engine_id, vllm_config, kv_cache_config, caches):
+    from vllm.config import set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.worker import (
+        NixlConnectorWorker,
+    )
+
+    use_mla = any(
+        isinstance(g.kv_cache_spec, MLAAttentionSpec)
+        for g in kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups
+    )
+    fake_backend = MagicMock()
+    fake_backend.get_name.return_value = "FLASHMLA" if use_mla else "FLASH_ATTN"
+    fake_backend.full_cls_name.return_value = "fake.backend"
+    fake_platform = MagicMock()
+    fake_platform.device_type = "cuda"
+    fake_platform.get_nixl_memory_type.return_value = "VRAM"
+    with (
+        patch.object(bw, "NixlWrapper", _RecordingNixl),
+        patch.object(bw, "get_tensor_model_parallel_rank", return_value=0),
+        patch.object(bw, "get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", return_value=1),
+        patch.object(bw, "get_current_attn_backends", return_value=[fake_backend]),
+        patch.object(bw, "select_common_block_size", lambda size, *_: size),
+        patch.object(bw, "current_platform", fake_platform),
+        patch(
+            "vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.mamba_utils.get_conv_state_layout",
+            return_value="DS",
+        ),
+        set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config),
+    ):
+        worker = NixlConnectorWorker(vllm_config, engine_id, kv_cache_config)
+        worker.use_mla = use_mla
+        worker.register_kv_caches(caches)
+    return worker
+
+
+def _cache_pages(cache, block):
+    """A layer's page(s) for one block: one tensor, or one per Mamba state."""
+    return (
+        [c[block] for c in cache]
+        if isinstance(cache, (list, tuple))
+        else [cache[block]]
+    )
+
+
+def _tag(page, *key):
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(hash(key) & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+    return torch.randint(1, 120, page.shape, generator=gen).to(page.dtype)
+
+
+def _run_recorded_copies(nixl):
+    """Run every recorded READ as memcpy: remote desc bytes -> local desc."""
+    import ctypes
+
+    for op, local_handle, local_ids, remote_handle, remote_ids in nixl.xfers:
+        assert op == "READ" and len(local_ids) == len(remote_ids)
+        for local_id, remote_id in zip(local_ids, remote_ids):
+            dst, dst_len, _ = (int(x) for x in nixl.dlists[local_handle][local_id])
+            src, src_len, _ = (int(x) for x in nixl.dlists[remote_handle][remote_id])
+            assert dst_len == src_len
+            ctypes.memmove(dst, src, dst_len)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model,p_layout,d_layout",
+    [(model, None, None) for model in _REAL_MODELS]
+    + [
+        ("DeepSeek-V3", "BLNHC", "BLNHC"),
+        ("DeepSeek-V3", "BLNHC", "LBNHC"),
+        ("Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B", "BLHNC", "BLHNC"),
+        ("NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2", "BLHNC", "BLHNC"),
+        ("Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B", "BLNHC", "BLNHC"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_real_model_layout_pull_copies_every_page(model, p_layout, d_layout):
+    """D pulls one request from P with each model's real KV plan: every page
+    of every layer arrives at D's block for the same layer and request
+    position, and nothing else in D's caches changes."""
+    from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.metadata import (
+        NixlConnectorMetadata,
+    )
+
+    p_config, p_kv_config, p_caches = _real_model_side(model, p_layout)
+    d_config, d_kv_config, d_caches = _real_model_side(model, d_layout)
+    p = _real_model_worker("P", p_config, p_kv_config, p_caches)
+    d = _real_model_worker("D", d_config, d_kv_config, d_caches)
+
+    # Block ids run up from 1 on P and down from the last block on D.
+    groups = d_kv_config.transfer_groups
+    p_ids: list[list[int]] = []
+    d_ids: list[list[int]] = []
+    for g in groups:
+        n = _blocks_per_request(g.kv_cache_spec)
+        p_ids.append([1 + sum(map(len, p_ids)) + k for k in range(n)])
+        d_ids.append(
+            [d_kv_config.num_blocks - 1 - sum(map(len, d_ids)) - k for k in range(n)]
+        )
+    for g, ids in zip(groups, p_ids):
+        for layer in g.layer_names:
+            for pos, block in enumerate(ids):
+                for part, page in enumerate(_cache_pages(p_caches[layer], block)):
+                    page.copy_(_tag(page, layer, pos, part))
+

+        p.xfer_handshake_metadata.agent_metadata_bytes

+    _register_remote_agents(d, meta, 1)

+    metadata.add_new_req_to_recv(
+        request_id="req",
+        local_block_ids=tuple(d_ids),
+        kv_transfer_params={
+            "remote_block_ids": p_ids,
+            "remote_engine_id": "P",
+            "remote_request_id": "prefill-req",
+            "remote_host": "remote-host",
+            "remote_port": 1234,
+            "tp_size": 1,
+        },
+    )
+    req = metadata.reqs_to_recv["req"]

+    d._recving_metadata["req"] = req
+    d._read_blocks_for_req("req", req)
+    assert d.nixl_wrapper.xfers
+    _run_recorded_copies(d.nixl_wrapper)
+
+    wrong = []
+    for g, ids in zip(groups, d_ids):
+        for layer in g.layer_names:
+            for pos, block in enumerate(ids):
+                for part, page in enumerate(_cache_pages(d_caches[layer], block)):
+                    if not torch.equal(page, _tag(page, layer, pos, part)):
+                        wrong.append(f"{layer}[{pos}].{part}")
+                    page.zero_()
+    assert not wrong, wrong[:8]

+        for t in (cache if isinstance(cache, (list, tuple)) else [cache])

+
+
+# Real model KV layouts, end to end on CPU: vLLM's planner and allocator build
+# P's and D's caches, D reads one request from P, and the recorded descriptors
+# are run as memory copies so every byte can be checked. Each case is the
+# first layers of a model with that model's per-layer KV specs. Hybrid block
+# sizes are the ones vLLM aligns to on CPU, where the attention page must hold
+# the Mamba state.
+_BF16 = torch.bfloat16
+
+
+def _attn(heads, head, head_v=None, window=None):
+    def make(block_size, _mamba_page):
+        kwargs = dict(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=heads,
+            head_size=head,
+            head_size_v=head_v or head,
+            dtype=_BF16,
+        )
+        if window is not None:
+            return SlidingWindowSpec(sliding_window=window, **kwargs)
+        return FullAttentionSpec(**kwargs)
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _mla(head=576, dtype=_BF16, **kwargs):
+    def make(block_size, _mamba_page):
+        return MLAAttentionSpec(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            num_kv_heads=1,
+            head_size=head,
+            dtype=dtype,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _mamba(shapes, mamba_type):
+    def make(block_size, mamba_page):
+        return MambaSpec(
+            block_size=block_size,
+            shapes=shapes,
+            dtypes=(_BF16, torch.float32),
+            page_size_padded=mamba_page,
+            mamba_type=mamba_type,
+        )
+
+    return make
+
+
+def _layers(n, make):
+    return [entry for i in range(n) for entry in make(i)]
+
+
+_GDN = MambaAttentionBackendEnum.GDN_ATTN
